notes.title: 5 New Language Support & New Achievements & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
SAY WELCOME TO OUR NEW PATCH 1.0.2!

[b]LANGUAGE[/b]
5 new language support added: Arabic, Korean, Polish, Portuguese, Hindi.

[b]ACHIEVEMENTS[/b]
8 new achievements added: 1 for Butterfly Cursor, 3 for Piano Cursor, 4 for Snake Cursor.
Some achievement bug fixes and some conditions re-adjusted.

[b]PRICES[/b]
Coin prices reduced.

[b]GENERAL IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
Bug causing moving objects to stop in Parker Mode fixed.
Improvement for 16:10 resolution.
Close button bug fixed in Market Menu.
Leaderboard Table scroll bug fixed.

Stay with us!

Curse the Cursor Team.
